# Use a 900k compaction threshold for the 1M Codex profile

## Disposition — proposal withdrawn before commit

Fresh runtime evidence supersedes the proposed 900k threshold. On 2026-09-30, both active GPT seats report `model_context_window: 828400` in their session token metadata. Their current model catalogs advertise `max_context_window: 872000` and `effective_context_window_percent: 95`; the new seat without the project override reports 258400. The earlier 950k calculation incorrectly applied 95% directly to the requested 1M setting without accounting for that ceiling.

The uncommitted 850k → 900k edit was reverted. No peer-local configuration changed and no PR was opened. A future compaction-policy change needs the active threshold/clamping semantics verified against the actual capacity; the operator's 5–10% suggestion is not being converted into an unsupported raw-window assumption. FM's missing repository context defaults remain a separate, confirmed defect.

The original proposal is retained below as history, not an active prescription.

---

## Context

During FM onboarding on 2026-09-30, the operator found that the new Codex seat used the model catalog's 258,400-token effective default while established Neo checkouts configured a 1,000,000-token window. Comparing project files also surfaced the repository's older 850,000-token compaction threshold. The operator requested a 5–10% buffer instead of 15%; this leaf selects 900,000 (10%).

## The Problem

`.codex/config.template.toml` retains `model_auto_compact_token_limit = 850000` from #10488 / #10503. The operator now prefers retaining more session context within the existing 1M profile. This is a repository policy choice, not a claim that OpenAI mandates one universal threshold or that a config value increases a model's supported capacity.

## The Architectural Reality

The Engine owns the tracked Codex project template. Existing peers' untracked `.codex/config.toml` files remain local policy. FM's missing-default initialization is a separate Brain provisioner correction; this ticket changes the source policy only.

OpenAI documents `model_context_window` and `model_auto_compact_token_limit` separately in the [configuration reference](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/config-file/config-reference#configtoml). The latter controls automatic history compaction.

## The Fix

Change the tracked template threshold to 900,000, retaining the 1,000,000-token window. Preserve the existing smaller-model adjustment guidance and every unrelated setting. Do not silently rewrite other peers' active local configurations.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: The template parses with `model_context_window = 1000000` and `model_auto_compact_token_limit = 900000`.
- [ ] AC-2: Unrelated settings and the smaller-model guidance remain unchanged.
- [ ] AC-3: Record that existing local overrides are not automatically migrated; adoption belongs to each seat's coordinated configuration update.

## Out of Scope

FM's template inheritance, model availability/pricing, undocumented output-limit behavior, and editing existing peers' private configuration.
